newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australian tyre firm buys rubber, RSS3 deals done.
newsitem.headline: Australian tyre firm buys rubber, RSS3 deals done.

text.p: An Australian tyre company bought on Thursday about 1,000 tonnes of TSR20 rubber for nearby shipment while local brokers arranged the purchase of several thousand tonnes of RSS3 grade rubber, dealers said.
"The Australians did the business," a dealer said, adding the rubber was for end-May or June shipment.
The price of the purchase ranged between 48 and 49 U.S. cents a lb, the traders said. "But we're not sure about the origin of the rubber," another dealer said.
Local dealers also arranged a series of deals for RSS3 grade rubber. "Almost all the months were done for," a trader said.
The total volume of RSS3 rubber traded reached about 5,600 tonnes. Volume for the other rubber grades was minimal.
Bridgestone was also said to have earlier been seeking offers in the morning, but there were no reports of deals, dealers said.

At around 0945 GMT, May RSS3 was seen at 116.00 U.S. cents a kg from 115.75 cents. May RSS1 was seen at 165.50 Singapore cents (US$1.15) a kg from 166.00. May TSR20 was seen steady at 156.00 Singapore cents (US$1.08) a kg. October/December TSR20 was seen at 115.00 U.S. cents a kg from 115.50 cents.
